svg.title: ∥A∥P = inf{t ≥0 : E has anchored regular derivative budget tbP , K has forced hit budget tkP }. (LCN1) The regular budget tests every left derivative through P’s order, in its permitted directions, on the healthy domain of that address, with its exponential support weight. The forced hit budget takes the absolute bound on every configuration and sums over addresses hitting each site. Both include the fixed locality and invariance conditions. The infimum is attained: take the least supremum envelope for each regular derivative family and each forced coefficient, and pass every finite nonnegative partial-sum inequality to the infimum. Hence ∥A∥P ≤t is equivalent to the two displayed budgets with that exact t. Triangle inequalities for derivatives and coefficients give subadditivity; scaling gives ∥cA∥P = |c|∥A∥P .
